anchors.paper_title: EEG-Based Dataset Explicitly Targets the Transitions between Sitting and Standing for Exploring Neural Activation Patterns in Motor Imagery and Execution
anchors.paper_venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
anchors.reason: Zenodo record by the same authors describes the 22-participant sit-to-stand/stand-to-sit EEG MI/ME dataset with 60-ch EEG, EOG, EMG, matching this dataset's DOI and details.

anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used in dataset conversion; it does not describe this sit-to-stand motor imagery dataset.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard extension that the dataset's BIDS formatting uses; it does not describe the sit-to-stand motor imagery dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1200 Hz from 60 scalp channels (10-05 montage), plus 2 EOG and 6 EMG channels, with trigger codes on a stim channel. Participants performed sit-to-stand and stand-to-sit transitions under motor execution and motor imagery conditions, with two rounds of 10 trials per task per session and a 4 s trial duration.
